# ChimCrew

> Family-owned, CSIA-certified chimney sweep, inspection, and repair company serving Columbus, Dayton, Cincinnati, Cleveland, and Pittsburgh.

ChimCrew has been keeping Ohio chimneys safe since 1975. We sweep wood, gas, and pellet systems; inspect for fire and water damage; rebuild crowns; install caps and liners; and handle leaks and masonry repair. Upfront flat-rate pricing, fully insured, same-day callbacks.
